headline: **MLB Daily Recap: May 24, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals secured a crucial win against the Cincinnati Reds, while the Houston Astros shut out the Chicago Cubs. The Toronto Blue Jays defeated the Pittsburgh Pirates in a recent matchup, and the Baltimore Orioles secured a victory over the Detroit Tigers.

Top MLB News:
The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Cincinnati Reds, securing an 8-1 victory. Jordan Walker led the Cardinals' offense with a home run and three RBIs. In a thrilling finish, the Cincinnati Reds edged out the St. Louis Cardinals 7-6, with Jordan Walker leading the Cardinals' offense with 3 hits, including a home run, and 4 RBIs. The Houston Astros secured a shutout victory over the Chicago Cubs, with a final score of 3-0. Christian Walker led the Astros' offense with a 3-hit, 2-home run performance. The Toronto Blue Jays defeated the Pittsburgh Pirates 5-2, securing a win on the road. Patrick Corbin earned the win for the Blue Jays, pitching 6.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 1 earned run. The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 4-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Spencer Horwitz, Oneil Cruz, and Esmerlyn Valdez contributing to the winning effort. The Baltimore Orioles secured a 3-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers in their recent matchup.

Injuries and Availability Impact:
Cole Winn has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Texas Rangers due to right arm fatigue. Jake Irvin has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Washington Nationals due to a right shoulder strain. Edward Cabrera has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Chicago Cubs retroactive to May 21, 2026, due to a right middle-finger blister. Jonny DeLuca has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Tampa Bay Rays retroactive to May 23, 2026, due to a right hamstring strain. Brant Hurter has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Detroit Tigers retroactive to May 23, 2026, due to lumbar spine inflammation. Lourdes Gurriel Jr. has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Arizona Diamondbacks due to a left hamstring strain. Carter Baumler has been placed on the 60-day injured list by the Texas Rangers due to a right intercostal strain. Jordan Hicks has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Chicago White Sox retroactive to May 21, 2026, due to a right lat strain.

Trades and Roster Movement:
The Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies for Future Considerations and International Bonus Pool Money. The Cincinnati Reds traded RF Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins for RHP Zach McCambley. The Tampa Bay Rays traded LHP Joe Rock to the Chicago White Sox for 3B Oliver Dunn. The Toronto Blue Jays traded LHP Eric Lauer to the Los Angeles Dodgers for cash.
